displayDescription: Navy-ground halftone print: a red idea sphere prints in dots, the light rakes across it, and four links print out to dotted nodes.
styleRenderer: Luminance-Based Halftone Shading (procedural Lambert sphere luminance mapped to area-proportional dots on fixed-angle screens)
motionEngine: GSAP paused timeline (window.__timelines.video) — sole owner of scene state, headline clip-path, caption bar scaleX and caption opacity
audioDescription: Silent preview. No music, voice or sound effects are included.
limitations: Illustrative procedural print simulation: ink overprint, paper stock and dot gain are approximated with flat Canvas 2D fills, not physically modelled.
Sphere shading is a simple Lambert luminance field used only to drive dot coverage; no real 3D render or photograph is used.
No preview recipe was supplied (tech.preview_recipes empty), so the refresh demonstrates the reviewed source-frame lessons: polarity-flipped ground and luminance-driven dots on fixed screens.
Silent: no soundtrack was requested for this preview.

Typography uses a declared @font-face 'PrintDisplay' mapped to local system fonts (Impact, Haettenschweiler, Arial Narrow Bold), falling back to Helvetica Neue/Arial bold; the caption bar is sized to fit either face.
